focus.source_evidence: Recurrence (occurrence, not a new root): hub #880 head 524c024d264df5d2ca71e693b95761c62a826978 marked ready 2026-10-26T01:01:05Z and merged 01:02:42Z as 2c2079327aec7b350f172146e5e50de4373cd926 while First-Pass Closure Gate run 40252128567 job 121346125131 was FAIL (receipt reason MISSING_RECEIPT: PR body held only the FPC_RECEIPT_V1 PENDING placeholder) and the Codex exact-head review was still Running. The other 19 checks passed. Same pattern for #865, #867, #854 and #871 is recorded in #876. #336 required-status canary still unproved. SYSTEMIC RESTATEMENT (same root, not a new id; recurrence PERSISTENT): read 2026-10-30T06:14Z at master b2509f3b3daf43fb652e9993974476747ddc49ea. Of the last 100 PRs merged into master (merged 2026-10-25T18:56:39Z..2026-10-29T16:31:39Z), the trusted status 'First-Pass Closure Gate / first-pass-closure' on the merge head was failure ('Trusted exact-head gate FAIL') for 97 and success for 3 (#1028, #998, #855); 13 of the 97 are Dependabot (#909-#923). All 116 master merges since 2026-10-24: 111 failure, 5 success (adds #844, #838). Root cause: ruleset 25789280 (P-BASIC, ~DEFAULT_BRANCH, active, no bypass actors) requires only validate-ultra-control, canonical-self-test-and-mutation and 'GOGREEN required gate'; first-pass-closure is not required (#336), and the gate fails closed without an FPC_RECEIPT_V1 body receipt and a zero-finding Codex exact-head review. Dependabot sub-case: a bot PR cannot write a receipt, so the policy needs an exemption or bot path. Examples: #880 (above); #933 head 2a3ea872 merged 2026-10-26T11:42:49Z as 7063a02f by GBOGEB one second after FPC run 40317092326 started, which then failed (GATE_OUTCOME=failure, RECEIPT_OUTCOME=failure, MISSING_RECEIPT, no FPC_RECEIPT_V1 block) while JADE and GOGREEN required gate were green; #1016, #960 and #940 (FAIL); Dependabot #923. A retroactive receipt on any merged PR is an owner decision and was not written. Owner decision relayed by the 'Draft PR review pass' session on 2026-10-30 (not verified here): 'Fix gate, then require' - stage it: first make FPC passable, then require it in the ruleset. Corrective action in progress in #1035: the gate derives the exact-head proof runs itself (no hand-written receipt), a policy-bound Dependabot exemption waives only the Codex review, and the gate re-checks when First-Pass Closure Proof completes. The ruleset change is the owner's step, only after #1035 lands and a post-merge canary run is green. Ruleset and FIRST_PASS_CLOSURE_POLICY_v1.json untouched by this record.
